description: NEW JERSEY – Bill Pascrell’s passing has left an immense void in the New Jersey delegation and, as we mourn his loss, we must also ensure that the work and commitment to the district continues on. I am heartened to see so many accomplished individuals raise their hand to serve – individuals who I deeply admire […]
